#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <cctype>

using namespace std;

pair<int, int> documentAnalyser(const string& doc) {
    bool inside = false;
    bool wasLetter = false;
    int maxLen = 0;
    int curLen = 0;
    int wordCount = 0;
    for (size_t idx = 0; idx < doc.length(); idx++) {
        char ch = doc[idx];
        if (ch == '(') {
            inside = true;
            wasLetter = false;
            curLen = 0;
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            inside = false;
            wasLetter = false;
            curLen = 0;
        } else if (isalpha(ch)) {
            if (inside && !wasLetter) {
                wordCount++;
            } else if (!inside) {
                curLen++;
                if (curLen > maxLen) maxLen = curLen;
            }
            wasLetter = true;
        } else {
            wasLetter = false;
            curLen = 0;
        }
    }
    return {maxLen, wordCount};
}

int main() {
    string line;
    getline(cin, line);
    size_t spacePos = line.find(' ');
    int n = stoi(line.substr(0, spacePos));
    string s = line.substr(spacePos + 1);
    pair<int, int> res = documentAnalyser(s);
    cout << res.first << " " << res.second;
    return 0;
}
